muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿أرأيت﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative, and «رأيت» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent). What is meant by ﴿أرأيت﴾ is "tell me" (أخبرني), and in that case it is transitive to two objects, the first being ﴿الذي﴾ and the second omitted, its implied form being: "who is he?" (من هو), or "is he not deserving of punishment?" (أليس مستحقا للعذاب). Or the seeing is visual, so the verb is transitive to one object. The clause ﴿أرأيت﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يكذب﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿يكذب﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بالدين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكذب﴾.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿فذلك﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), because it is the answer of an implied condition, the implied wording being: "if you do not know him, then that is..." (إن لم تعرفه فذلك), or "if you seek knowledge of him, then that is..." (إن طلبت علمه فذلك), or "if you consider him, then that is..." (إن تأملته فذلك). In «ذلك», «ذا» is a demonstrative indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf is a particle of address.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «ذلك».
﴿يدع﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿يدع﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿اليتيم﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa. The clause ﴿فذلك...﴾ is in the position of jussive as the answer of the implied condition.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿يحض﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and its agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿على طعام﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحض﴾.
﴿المسكين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; the clause ﴿لا يحض﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿يدع﴾.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿فويل﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), i.e. "when you know that he is characterised by these qualities, then woe…" (إذا علمت أنه متصف بهذه الصفات فويل), or "when the matter is so, then woe…" (إذا كان الأمر كذلك فويل); or the fāʾ is resumptive; and «ويل» is mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma.
﴿للمصلين﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «المصلين» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted that is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿ويل للمصلين﴾ is the answer of the implied non-jussive condition, or resumptive, and on both views it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿المصلين﴾.
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿عن صلاتهم﴾: «عن» is a preposition, and «صلاة» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by «عن», the sign of its genitive being the kasra, and it is muḍāf, and the pronoun is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ساهون﴾.
﴿ساهون﴾: khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause ﴿هم عن صلاتهم ساهون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of genitive as a second naʿt (adjective) of «المصلين».
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يراءون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يراءون﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «هم», and the clause ﴿هم يراءون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿ويمنعون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يمنعون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent).
﴿الماعون﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يمنعون﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the first object of «يمنعون» is omitted, i.e. "they withhold small kindnesses from people" (يمنعون الناس الماعون), or "they withhold small kindnesses from those who ask" (يمنعون الطالبين الماعون); the clause ﴿يمنعون﴾ is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ﴿يراءون﴾.
